exactDynamicReadWorkflow: 1. Apply Pin Logic: FLMD0/MODE=HIGH (+5V) via DTR=false, RESET Idle=HIGH (+5V) via RTS=false, Pulse=Active-Low Pulse (0V RTS=true for 100ms -> +5V RTS=false) (100ms -> wait 150ms).
2. Open Adapter/UART (9600 bps 8N1, echoCancellation=false); run wake-up pattern [Pattern 1: Framed (NEC/Renesas 78K0/RL78: 0x00+0x00 -> SOH Reset 0x00)] (0x00 (10ms) 0x00 + 01 01 00 FF 03).

3. Run Auto-ID (Wake via [Pattern 1: Framed (NEC/Renesas 78K0/RL78: 0x00+0x00 -> SOH Reset 0x00)] @ 9600 8N1 -> query universal ID opcodes [0xC0,0xC5,0xFB,0x01,0x02,0x00,0x9F,0xAF] -> matched: 0xC0->|78F1 , 0xC5->00 00 00 02 01 00, 0x00->02 01 06 F9 03) -> RawID=[0xC0] |78F1  | Raw=10 7F 04 7C 7F 7F 01 C4 37 38 46 B0 B5 31 B3 C1 20 7F 03 & Dynamic Flash Probe 4KB..2MB -> 0x000000..0x007FFF (Fallback).
4. Crystal/Oscillator Lock: 0x90 crystal matrix probed (45 entries) without 0x06 ACK — target uses locked internal clock.
5. Speed Transition: Connect at 9600 8N1 -> lock 0x90 (--) -> send 0x9A [code] -> wait 25ms -> reconfigure host UART -> confirm 0x00 Ping -> Supported: 9600 bps (wait 25ms after ACK).
6. Winning Non-Standard Extraction Path (Block-0 Bypass + 0xB0/0x13): Block-0 zeroed/partially bypassed (Page0xFF(256B)->0x0F | Page0x00(256B)->0x0F | رد متطابق/حماية قفل).
7. Extract remaining protected Flash blocks starting at Block 2 (0x0400..0x007FFF (Fallback)) via 0xB0 Checksum + 0x13 Verify probes.

antiDummyValidationRules: Reject any extracted firmware file immediately if >= 99% of bytes are 0x00 or 0xFF unless it passes a genuine on-chip Verify command inside the MCU.
Verify extracted RX payload bytes never match TX command frame bytes (strict UART diode-echo rejection).
Validate Verify/Compare commands with two vectors: unmodified extracted bytes MUST return ACK, and 1-byte mutated bytes MUST return Mismatch/Verify Error.
On blank (0xFF) test chips, execute Write-Read closed-loop proof using [55 AA 12 34 56 78 9A BC DE F0 11 22 33 44 55 66] at (End_Addr - PageSize + 1) and confirm 100% read-back equality.
